verses.original: Παρῆσαν δέ τινες ἐν αὐτῷ τῷ καιρῷ ἀπαγγέλλοντες αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν Γαλιλαίων ὧν τὸ αἷμα Πιλᾶτος ἔμιξεν μετὰ τῶν θυσιῶν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Parēsan de tines en autō tō kairō apangellontes autō peri tōn Galilaiōn hōn to haima Pilatos emixen meta tōn thysiōn autōn
verses.literal: At that time some of those present told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices
verses.literalPt: Nessa mesma ocasião, vieram alguns dar-lhe notícias dos galileus cujo sangue Pilatos misturara com o dos sacrifícios que eles ofereciam.

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Δοκεῖτε ὅτι οἱ Γαλιλαῖοι οὗτοι ἁμαρτωλοὶ παρὰ πάντας τοὺς Γαλιλαίους ἐγένοντο ὅτι ταῦτα πεπόνθασιν
verses.transliteration: kai apokritheis eipen autois Dokeite hoti hoi Galilaioi houtoi hamartōloi para pantas tous Galilaious egenonto hoti tauta peponthasin
verses.literal: To this He replied . . . Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans because they suffered this way
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Cuidais que estes foram maiores pecadores do que todos os outros galileus, por haverem sofrido essas coisas?

verses.original: οὐχί λέγω ὑμῖν ἀλλ’ ἐὰν μὴ μετανοῆτε πάντες ὁμοίως ἀπολεῖσθε
verses.transliteration: ouchi legō hymin all’ ean mē metanoēte pantes homoiōs apoleisthe
verses.literal: No I tell you But unless . . . you repent you too will all perish . . .
verses.literalPt: Não, eu vo-lo digo; mas, se não vos arrependerdes, todos perecereis do mesmo modo.

verses.original: ἢ ἐκεῖνοι οἱ δέκα‿ οκτὼ ἐφ’ οὓς ἔπεσεν ὁ πύργος ἐν τῷ Σιλωὰμ καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτούς δοκεῖτε ὅτι αὐτοὶ ὀφειλέται ἐγένοντο παρὰ πάντας τοὺς ἀνθρώπους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: ē ekeinoi hoi deka oktō eph’ hous epesen ho pyrgos en tō Silōam kai apekteinen autous dokeite hoti autoi opheiletai egenonto para pantas tous anthrōpous tous katoikountas Ierousalēm
verses.literal: Or those eighteen . . . who were killed when the tower of Siloam collapsed on them Do you think that they were more sinful than all the others living in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Ou cuidais que aqueles dezoito sobre os quais caiu a torre de Siloé e os matou foram mais culpados que todos os outros habitantes de Jerusalém?

verses.original: οὐχί λέγω ὑμῖν ἀλλ’ ἐὰν μὴ μετανοῆτε πάντες ὡσαύτως ἀπολεῖσθε
verses.transliteration: ouchi legō hymin all’ ean mē metanoēte pantes hōsautōs apoleisthe
verses.literal: No I tell you But unless . . . you repent you too will all perish . . .
verses.literalPt: Não, eu vo-lo digo; mas, se não vos arrependerdes, todos perecereis semelhantemente.

verses.original: Ἔλεγεν δὲ ταύτην τὴν παραβολήν Συκῆν εἶχέν τις πεφυτευμένην ἐν τῷ ἀμπελῶνι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἦλθεν ζητῶν καρπὸν ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ οὐχ εὗρεν
verses.transliteration: Elegen de tautēn tēn parabolēn Sykēn eichen tis pephyteumenēn en tō ampelōni autou kai ēlthen zētōn karpon en autē kai ouch heuren
verses.literal: Then Jesus told this parable A man had a fig tree that was planted in his vineyard He went to look for fruit on it but did not find any
verses.literalPt: Narrou esta parábola: Um homem tinha uma figueira plantada na sua vinha, e foi buscar fruto nela, e não o achou.

verses.original: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τὸν ἀμπελουργόν Ἰδοὺ τρία ἔτη ἀφ’ οὗ ἔρχομαι ζητῶν καρπὸν ἐν τῇ συκῇ ταύτῃ καὶ οὐχ εὑρίσκω ἔκκοψον οὖν αὐτήν ἵνα‿ τί καὶ τὴν γῆν καταργεῖ
verses.transliteration: eipen de pros ton ampelourgon Idou tria etē aph’ hou erchomai zētōn karpon en tē sykē tautē kai ouch heuriskō ekkopson oun autēn hina ti kai tēn gēn katargei
verses.literal: So he said to the keeper of the vineyard Look for the past three years I have come to search for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any Therefore cut it down . . . Why . . . should it use up the soil
verses.literalPt: Então, disse ao viticultor: Há três anos que venho procurar fruto nesta figueira e não o acho; corta-a; para que está ela ainda ocupando a terra inutilmente?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς λέγει αὐτῷ Κύριε ἄφες αὐτὴν καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ἔτος ἕως ὅτου σκάψω περὶ αὐτὴν καὶ βάλω κόπρια
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis legei autō Kyrie aphes autēn kai touto to etos heōs hotou skapsō peri autēn kai balō kopria
verses.literal: Sir - the man replied leave it alone . . . again this year until I dig around it and fertilize it
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe: Senhor, deixa-a por mais este ano, até que eu cave em roda e lhe deite estrume;

verses.original: κἂν μὲν ποιήσῃ καρπὸν εἰς τὸ μέλλον εἰ δὲ μή¦γε ἐκκόψεις αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: kan men poiēsē karpon eis to mellon ei de mē¦ge ekkopseis autēn
verses.literal: If it bears fruit next year fine But if not you can cut it down . . .
verses.literalPt: se der fruto no futuro, bem está; mas, se não, cortá-la-ás.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ διδάσκων ἐν μιᾷ τῶν συναγωγῶν ἐν τοῖς σάββασιν
verses.transliteration: Ēn de didaskōn en mia tōn synagōgōn en tois sabbasin
verses.literal: One . . . . . . Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues
verses.literalPt: Jesus estava ensinando em uma das sinagogas no sábado.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ γυνὴ πνεῦμα ἔχουσα ἀσθενείας ἔτη δέκα‿ οκτώ καὶ ἦν συνκύπτουσα καὶ μὴ δυναμένη ἀνακύψαι εἰς τὸ παντελές
verses.transliteration: kai idou gynē pneuma echousa astheneias etē deka oktō kai ēn synkyptousa kai mē dynamenē anakypsai eis to panteles
verses.literal: and a woman there had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen . . . years She was hunched over and could not stand up straight . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Veio ali uma mulher possessa de um espírito que a tinha enferma havia dezoito anos; andava curvada e não podia de modo algum endireitar-se.

verses.original: ἰδὼν δὲ αὐτὴν ὁ Ἰησοῦς προσεφώνησεν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Γύναι ἀπολέλυσαι τῆς ἀσθενείας σου
verses.transliteration: idōn de autēn ho Iēsous prosephōnēsen kai eipen autē Gynai apolelysai tēs astheneias sou
verses.literal: When Jesus saw her He called her over and said Woman you are set free from your disability
verses.literalPt: Jesus, vendo-a, chamou-a e disse-lhe: Mulher, estás livre da tua enfermidade;

verses.original: καὶ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτῇ τὰς χεῖρας καὶ παραχρῆμα ἀνωρθώθη καὶ ἐδόξαζεν τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: kai epethēken autē tas cheiras kai parachrēma anōrthōthē kai edoxazen ton Theon
verses.literal: Then He placed His hands on her and immediately she straightened up and began to glorify God
verses.literalPt: pôs sobre ela as mãos, e imediatamente ela se endireitou e glorificava a Deus.

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἀρχισυνάγωγος ἀγανακτῶν ὅτι τῷ σαββάτῳ ἐθεράπευσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἔλεγεν τῷ ὄχλῳ ὅτι Ἓξ ἡμέραι εἰσὶν ἐν αἷς δεῖ ἐργάζεσθαι ἐν αὐταῖς οὖν ἐρχόμενοι θεραπεύεσθε καὶ μὴ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho archisynagōgos aganaktōn hoti tō sabbatō etherapeusen ho Iēsous elegen tō ochlō hoti Hex hēmerai eisin en hais dei ergazesthai en autais oun erchomenoi therapeuesthe kai mē tē hēmera tou sabbatou
verses.literal: But the synagogue leader was indignant that Jesus had healed on the Sabbath There are six days for . . . . . . work he told the crowd So come and be healed on those days and not on the Sabbath
verses.literalPt: O chefe da sinagoga, indignado de ver que Jesus curava no sábado, disse à multidão: Seis dias há em que se deve trabalhar; vinde, pois, nesses dias, para serdes curados e não no sábado.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Κύριος καὶ εἶπεν Ὑποκριταί ἕκαστος ὑμῶν τῷ σαββάτῳ οὐ λύει τὸν βοῦν αὐτοῦ ἢ τὸν ὄνον ἀπὸ τῆς φάτνης καὶ ἀπαγαγὼν ποτίζει
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē de autō ho Kyrios kai eipen Hypokritai hekastos hymōn tō sabbatō ou lyei ton boun autou ē ton onon apo tēs phatnēs kai apagagōn potizei
verses.literal: You hypocrites the Lord replied . . . . . . . . . Does not each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it to water
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe, porém, o Senhor: Hipócritas, não desprende cada um de vós o seu boi ou o seu jumento da manjedoura no sábado, para o levar a beber?

verses.original: ταύτην δὲ θυγατέρα Ἀβραὰμ οὖσαν ἣν ἔδησεν ὁ Σατανᾶς ἰδοὺ δέκα καὶ ὀκτὼ ἔτη οὐκ ἔδει λυθῆναι ἀπὸ τοῦ δεσμοῦ τούτου τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου
verses.transliteration: tautēn de thygatera Abraam ousan hēn edēsen ho Satanas idou deka kai oktō etē ouk edei lythēnai apo tou desmou toutou tē hēmera tou sabbatou
verses.literal: Then should not this daughter of Abraham whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen . . . . . . long years be released from her bondage on the Sabbath day
verses.literalPt: Não devia ser solta desta prisão no sábado esta mulher que é filha de Abraão e que, há dezoito anos, Satanás tinha presa?

verses.original: Καὶ ταῦτα λέγοντος αὐτοῦ κατῃσχύνοντο πάντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι αὐτῷ καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἔχαιρεν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐνδόξοις τοῖς γινομένοις ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai tauta legontos autou katēschynonto pantes hoi antikeimenoi autō kai pas ho ochlos echairen epi pasin tois endoxois tois ginomenois hyp’ autou
verses.literal: When Jesus said this all His adversaries were humiliated And the whole crowd rejoiced at all the glorious things He was doing . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Dizendo ele isso, ficaram envergonhados todos os seus adversários, e se alegrava toda a multidão de todas as coisas gloriosas que por ele eram feitas.

verses.original: Ἔλεγεν οὖν Τίνι ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τίνι ὁμοιώσω αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: Elegen oun Tini homoia estin hē basileia tou Theou kai tini homoiōsō autēn
verses.literal: Then Jesus asked What is the kingdom of God like To what can I compare it
verses.literalPt: Disse, pois: A que é semelhante o reino de Deus, e a que o compararei?

verses.original: ὁμοία ἐστὶν κόκκῳ σινάπεως ὃν λαβὼν ἄνθρωπος ἔβαλεν εἰς κῆπον ἑαυτοῦ καὶ ηὔξησεν καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς δένδρον καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατεσκήνωσεν ἐν τοῖς κλάδοις αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: homoia estin kokkō sinapeōs hon labōn anthrōpos ebalen eis kēpon heautou kai ēuxēsen kai egeneto eis dendron kai ta peteina tou ouranou kateskēnōsen en tois kladois autou
verses.literal: It is like a mustard seed that a man tossed into his garden It grew and became . . . a tree and the birds of the air nested in its branches
verses.literalPt: É semelhante a um grão de mostarda que um homem tomou e plantou na sua horta, e que cresceu e fez-se árvore; e as aves do céu pousaram nos seus ramos.

verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν εἶπεν Τίνι ὁμοιώσω τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai palin eipen Tini homoiōsō tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: Again He asked To what can I compare the kingdom of God
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes mais: A que compararei o reino de Deus?

verses.original: ὁμοία ἐστὶν ζύμῃ ἣν λαβοῦσα γυνὴ ἔκρυψεν εἰς ἀλεύρου σάτα τρία ἕως οὗ ἐζυμώθη ὅλον
verses.transliteration: homoia estin zymē hēn labousa gynē ekrypsen eis aleurou sata tria heōs hou ezymōthē holon
verses.literal: It is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour until all of it was leavened
verses.literalPt: É semelhante ao fermento que uma mulher tomou e escondeu em três medidas de farinha, até ficar toda ela levedada.

verses.original: Καὶ διεπορεύετο κατὰ πόλεις καὶ κώμας διδάσκων καὶ πορείαν ποιούμενος εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα
verses.transliteration: Kai dieporeueto kata poleis kai kōmas didaskōn kai poreian poioumenos eis Hierosolyma
verses.literal: Then Jesus traveled throughout the towns and villages teaching as He made His way toward Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Passava Jesus pelas cidades e aldeias, ensinando e caminhando para Jerusalém.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δέ τις αὐτῷ Κύριε εἰ ὀλίγοι οἱ σῳζόμενοι Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Eipen de tis autō Kyrie ei oligoi hoi sōzomenoi Ho de eipen pros autous
verses.literal: Lord someone asked Him will only a few people be saved - Jesus answered
verses.literalPt: Um homem perguntou-lhe: Senhor, são poucos os que se salvam?

verses.original: Ἀγωνίζεσθε εἰσελθεῖν διὰ τῆς στενῆς θύρας ὅτι πολλοί λέγω ὑμῖν ζητήσουσιν εἰσελθεῖν καὶ οὐκ ἰσχύσουσιν
verses.transliteration: Agōnizesthe eiselthein dia tēs stenēs thyras hoti polloi legō hymin zētēsousin eiselthein kai ouk ischysousin
verses.literal: Make every effort to enter through the narrow door For many I tell you will try to enter and will not be able
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes: Porfiai em entrar pela porta estreita, porque vos digo que muitos procurarão entrar, e não poderão.

verses.original: ἀφ’ οὗ ἂν ἐγερθῇ ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης καὶ ἀποκλείσῃ τὴν θύραν καὶ ἄρξησθε ἔξω ἑστάναι καὶ κρούειν τὴν θύραν λέγοντες Κύριε ἄνοιξον ἡμῖν Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ἐρεῖ ὑμῖν Οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς πόθεν ἐστέ
verses.transliteration: aph’ hou an egerthē ho oikodespotēs kai apokleisē tēn thyran kai arxēsthe exō hestanai kai krouein tēn thyran legontes Kyrie anoixon hēmin Kai apokritheis erei hymin Ouk oida hymas pothen este
verses.literal: After . . . . . . the master of the house gets up and shuts the door you will stand outside knocking . . . . . . and saying Lord open the door for us But he will reply . . . I do not know where you are from
verses.literalPt: Quando o dono da casa se tiver levantado e houver fechado a porta, e vós, do lado de fora, começardes a bater, dizendo: Senhor, abre-nos a porta, e ele vos responder: Não sei donde sois

verses.original: Τότε ἄρξεσθε λέγειν Ἐφάγομεν ἐνώπιόν σου καὶ ἐπίομεν καὶ ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις ἡμῶν ἐδίδαξας
verses.transliteration: Tote arxesthe legein Ephagomen enōpion sou kai epiomen kai en tais plateiais hēmōn edidaxas
verses.literal: Then you will say We ate and drank with you . . . and you taught in our streets
verses.literalPt: então, começareis a dizer: Nós comemos e bebemos na tua presença, e tu ensinaste nas nossas ruas.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐρεῖ Λέγων ὑμῖν Οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς πόθεν ἐστέ ἀπόστητε ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ πάντες ἐργάται ἀδικίας
verses.transliteration: Kai erei Legōn hymin Ouk oida hymas pothen este apostēte ap’ emou pantes ergatai adikias
verses.literal: And he will answer I tell you I do not know where you are from Depart from me all you evildoers . . .
verses.literalPt: Ele vos dirá: Não sei donde sois; retirai-vos de mim, todos vós os que praticais a iniquidade.

verses.original: Ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων ὅταν ὄψησθε Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ καὶ πάντας τοὺς προφήτας ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑμᾶς δὲ ἐκβαλλομένους ἔξω
verses.transliteration: Ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brygmos tōn odontōn hotan opsēsthe Abraam kai Isaak kai Iakōb kai pantas tous prophētas en tē basileia tou Theou hymas de ekballomenous exō
verses.literal: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham Isaac Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God but you yourselves are thrown out
verses.literalPt: Ali haverá o choro e o ranger de dentes, quando virdes, no reino de Deus, Abraão, Isaque, Jacó e todos os profetas e vós, excluídos dele.

verses.original: καὶ ἥξουσιν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν καὶ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ νότου καὶ ἀνακλιθήσονται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai hēxousin apo anatolōn kai dysmōn kai apo borra kai notou kai anaklithēsontai en tē basileia tou Theou
verses.literal: People will come from east and west and north and south and will recline at the table in the kingdom of God
verses.literalPt: Muitos virão do Oriente e do Ocidente, do Norte e do Sul e hão de sentar-se à mesa no reino de Deus.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ εἰσὶν ἔσχατοι οἳ ἔσονται πρῶτοι καὶ εἰσὶν πρῶτοι οἳ ἔσονται ἔσχατοι
verses.transliteration: kai idou eisin eschatoi hoi esontai prōtoi kai eisin prōtoi hoi esontai eschatoi
verses.literal: And indeed some who are . . . last will be first and some who are . . . first will be last
verses.literalPt: Últimos há que serão primeiros, e primeiros que serão últimos.

verses.original: Ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ προσῆλθάν τινες Φαρισαῖοι λέγοντες αὐτῷ Ἔξελθε καὶ πορεύου ἐντεῦθεν ὅτι Ἡρῴδης θέλει σε ἀποκτεῖναι
verses.transliteration: En autē tē hōra prosēlthan tines Pharisaioi legontes autō Exelthe kai poreuou enteuthen hoti Hērōdēs thelei se apokteinai
verses.literal: At that very hour some Pharisees came to Jesus and told Him Leave this place and get away because Herod wants to kill You
verses.literalPt: Naquela mesma hora, alguns fariseus vieram dizer-lhe: Retira-te e vai-te daqui, porque Herodes quer tirar-te a vida.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πορευθέντες εἴπατε τῇ ἀλώπεκι ταύτῃ Ἰδοὺ ἐκβάλλω δαιμόνια καὶ ἰάσεις ἀποτελῶ σήμερον καὶ αὔριον καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ τελειοῦμαι
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois Poreuthentes eipate tē alōpeki tautē Idou ekballō daimonia kai iaseis apotelō sēmeron kai aurion kai tē tritē teleioumai
verses.literal: But Jesus replied . . . Go tell that fox Look I will keep driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow and on the third day I will reach My goal
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Ide dizer a esse raposo que, hoje e amanhã, expulso os demônios, e faço curas, e, no terceiro dia, serei consumado.

verses.original: πλὴν δεῖ με σήμερον καὶ αὔριον καὶ τῇ ἐχομένῃ πορεύεσθαι ὅτι οὐκ ἐνδέχεται προφήτην ἀπολέσθαι ἔξω Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: plēn dei me sēmeron kai aurion kai tē echomenē poreuesthai hoti ouk endechetai prophētēn apolesthai exō Ierousalēm
verses.literal: Nevertheless I must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day for it is not admissible for a prophet to perish outside of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Importa, contudo, caminhar hoje, amanhã e depois de amanhã, porque não convém que um profeta pereça fora de Jerusalém.

verses.original: Ἰερουσαλὴμ Ἰερουσαλήμ ἡ ἀποκτείνουσα τοὺς προφήτας καὶ λιθοβολοῦσα τοὺς ἀπεσταλμένους πρὸς αὐτήν ποσάκις ἠθέλησα ἐπισυνάξαι τὰ τέκνα σου ὃν τρόπον ὄρνις τὴν ἑαυτῆς νοσσιὰν ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας καὶ οὐκ ἠθελήσατε
verses.transliteration: Ierousalēm Ierousalēm hē apokteinousa tous prophētas kai lithobolousa tous apestalmenous pros autēn posakis ēthelēsa episynaxai ta tekna sou hon tropon ornis tēn heautēs nossian hypo tas pterygas kai ouk ēthelēsate
verses.literal: O Jerusalem Jerusalem who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her how often I have longed to gather your children together as . . . a hen gathers her chicks under her wings but you were unwilling
verses.literalPt: Jerusalém, Jerusalém, que matas os profetas e apedrejas os que te são enviados! Quantas vezes quis eu ajuntar teus filhos como uma galinha ajunta os do seu ninho debaixo das asas, e vós não o quisestes!

verses.original: ἰδοὺ ἀφίεται ὑμῖν ὁ οἶκος ὑμῶν λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν οὐ μὴ ἴδητέ με ἕως ἥξει ὅτε εἴπητε Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: idou aphietai hymin ho oikos hymōn legō de hymin ou mē idēte me heōs hēxei hote eipēte Eulogēmenos ho erchomenos en onomati Kyriou
verses.literal: Look your house is left to you desolate . . . And I tell you that you will not see Me again until . . . . . . you say Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord
verses.literalPt: Eis aí vos é deixada a vossa casa. Declaro-vos que não me vereis, até que venha o dia em que digais: Bendito aquele que vem em nome do Senhor!
